requires: a free call with real data (an MCP tool answers content, or an A2A agent answers a message / task result with content and no error; the class probe of the class asked passes when the layer has one)
a readable card and a payTo (an MCP seller: on Base; an A2A seller: its own address on its own chain), or with no card: its ERC-8004 agentWallet / owner and an endpoint of it probed answering
terms that do not forbid resale

the class fits the tool (CLASS_FIT_v1, the class-fit table): its code check passed, or it is the door class, or the tool names the class words, was called with the class input and answered a field of the class kind; else 422 class_mismatch

AUTO_ONBOARD_HTTP_v1 ({ resource, class, venue? }): a resource its seller published on a venue the pass reads, an EVM payTo there, ONE unpaid call with the class input answered with data that passes the class fit and the content gate; a 402 is x402_only (never paid: it needs an outside buyer's first paid call), a web page or no answer is refused

infers.price: the seller's own accepts on Base, else its spec price, else 1000 micro-USDC (the scheme minimum)

trimmed: get_key (the free-key offer every keyless answer carries)
